metadata.name: Customer Support
metadata.hero: How is your support team actually performing?
metadata.description: Quickly understand how your customer support team is performing day to day, so you can catch problems before they show up in escalations.

capabilities.name: Ticket Volume & Trends
capabilities.description: Tickets created vs solved over time, by channel, priority, type, or group

capabilities.name: Resolution Time
capabilities.description: First reply, first resolution, and full resolution, in business or calendar hours

capabilities.name: Backlog Health
capabilities.description: Open ticket count and aging by priority and assignee

capabilities.name: Agent Performance
capabilities.description: Per-agent volume, resolution time, replies, reopens, and CSAT

capabilities.name: SLA Performance
capabilities.description: Breach rate and time-to-breach by SLA metric

capabilities.name: Satisfaction (CSAT)
capabilities.description: Score distribution and trends by agent and channel

example_questions: What's our average first reply time over the last 30 days, business hours only?
Who are our top 10 agents by ticket volume this quarter, and how do resolution times compare?
What's our SLA breach rate this quarter, and which metric is driving it?
How many tickets are in backlog right now, and what's the priority breakdown?
How does CSAT distribute by channel?

quickstart_models.description: dbt models produced by the fivetran/zendesk package. The skill's resolution-time, backlog, agent-performance, and SLA analyses require at minimum zendesk__ticket_enriched and zendesk__ticket_metrics. SLA-specific queries require zendesk__sla_policies; backlog-over-time requires zendesk__ticket_field_history / zendesk__ticket_backlog.
